title: Pure Infernity
summary: The page's 2026 deck structure without the Fiendsmith engine: Infernity cards with Archfiend's Usurpation and Archfiend's Roar, plus generic staples. Infernity cards only work while your hand is empty: Infernity Archfiend searches as soon as it is summoned, Necromancer and Mirage revive the others, and Infernity Barrier negates anything while you hold nothing. Archfiend's Usurpation, the page's new starter (it calls it "Archfiend Usurpation"), Sets Archfiend's Roar to revive Infernity Archfiend the same turn. Infernity Launcher is Limited.

allow.Archfiend's Usurpation: The page's 2026 starter: Sets Archfiend's Roar from the Deck, live that turn.
allow.Archfiend's Roar: Revives Infernity Archfiend, which is an Archfiend, the turn Usurpation Sets it.

main: Infernity Archfiend
Summoned with an empty hand: searches an Infernity card.
Infernity Necromancer
With an empty hand, revives an Infernity each turn.
Infernity Mirage
Tributes itself to revive two Infernities.
Infernity Wildcat
Tuner that summons itself by discarding an Infernity.
Infernity Sage
Tuner: discards your whole hand; sent to the GY, mills an Infernity.
Infernity Beetle
Tuner that Tributes itself for two more copies from the Deck.
Infernity Conjurer
Revives itself and shrinks their monsters.
Infernity Patriarch
Summons itself as your last card; protects Infernities from the GY.
Infernity Queen
2026 support. From the GY, banishes a DARK to let a DARK attack directly.
Infernity Avenger
Tuner that revives at a destroyed monster's Level.
Infernity General
Banishes itself to revive two small Infernities.
Archfiend's Usurpation
2026 starter: Sets Archfiend's Roar, live that turn.
Infernity Launcher
Limited. Discards Infernities and revives two.
Infernity Paranoia
Tributes a DARK to summon a same-Level Infernity.
This Creepy Little Punk
Counts as Infernity: revives one from anywhere.
Infernity Barrier
Counter Trap with an empty hand: negates anything.
Archfiend's Roar
Revives Infernity Archfiend for its search.
Infernity Break
Banishes an Infernity to destroy a card.
Infernity Suppression
Live the turn it's Set with an empty hand: negates a monster effect.
extra: Level 6 Synchro: negates and destroys a card with an empty hand.
Level 8 Synchro: destroys a monster and burns with an empty hand.
Link-4: Special Summons from hand and draws 4 cards then places 3 on the bottom of the Deck when made with 4 materials.
